# Data Manipulation

![Data Manipulation function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/numeric/31-manipulation-de-donnees.svg)

[Numeric functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Opens numeric data representation and bit manipulation functions.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Manipulation de donnees**

Ouvre les fonctions de representation et de manipulation des bits numeriques.

</details>

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Adapt To Type](data_manipulation/adapt_to_type.md) | Adapts a numeric value to the type supplied as its target. |
| [Flatten To Byte Array](data_manipulation/flatten_to_byte_array.md) | Flattens a numeric value into its byte-array representation. |
| [Unflatten From Byte Array](data_manipulation/unflatten_from_byte_array.md) | Reconstructs a numeric value from a byte-array representation. |
| [Mantissa &amp; Exponent](data_manipulation/mantissa_exponent.md) | Separates a floating-point value into its mantissa and exponent. |
| [Rotate Left With Carry](data_manipulation/rotate_left_with_carry.md) | Rotates the bits left while including the carry bit. |
| [Rotate Right With Carry](data_manipulation/rotate_right_with_carry.md) | Rotates the bits right while including the carry bit. |
| [Logical Shift](data_manipulation/logical_shift.md) | Shifts the bits logically by the requested amount. |
| [Rotate](data_manipulation/rotate.md) | Rotates the bits by the requested amount. |
| [Split Number](data_manipulation/split_number.md) | Splits a numeric value into lower and upper parts. |
| [Join Numbers](data_manipulation/join_numbers.md) | Joins lower and upper numeric parts into one value. |
| [Swap Bytes](data_manipulation/swap_bytes.md) | Reverses the byte order within each word of the value. |
| [Swap Words](data_manipulation/swap_words.md) | Reverses the word order within the numeric value. |
| [Reinterpret Number](data_manipulation/reinterpret_number.md) | Reinterprets the stored bits using another numeric representation. |
